title: docs(pm-dispatch): the ruling procedure writes a banner onto the card body
body:
Fixes #19256

Clause-②: no

A ruling that lands as a COMMENT left the card BODY asserting the opposite, and nothing reconciled the two. The body is what a taker reads first, so a ruled card went on advertising itself as un-dispatchable — measured at 11 and 15 days on two live cards.

The director charter's 授权与形态 section already fixes the first line of the ruling COMMENT. This adds the sibling rule for the first line of the BODY, in the same stroke that records the ruling.

## What changed

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/director.md` — three lines, inserted directly after the 「裁决评论首行固定一条」 line. Nothing else in the file moved; no line was deleted or re-wrapped.

Their content, described rather than quoted (the landed bytes carry the corpus's usual angle-bracket placeholders; this body spells them as words, per the body-sanitizer rule in AGENTS.md):

1. **The act and its shape** — recording a ruling writes, in the same stroke, a one-line banner on the body's first line: the literal `Ruled:` followed by the ruling comment id, the letter, and the UTC stamp, separated by the middle dot the sibling comment line already uses. Closes with ⛔ 不新增标签与状态 — both measured instances were in the **correct** state the whole time, so the clause adds no label and no state.
2. **The strike, the reader and the failure mode** — the body's own 「⛔ 不派 / 决策卡」 assertion is struck in that same stroke; skipping it means the body contradicts a landed ruling, and 接卡者先读正文 sends the next taker back to the decision box exactly as before.
3. **The channel** — the banner goes through `post-stamped --body`, whose acknowledgement flag names the newest comment, so that acknowledgement IS the thread read the charter's 裁前先读线程 line already requires. No new tool capability: the act is the seat's, spelled in the procedure.

### Why 授权与形态 and not 职责二

One home, not both. 授权与形态 is the shape section, and the new lines sit beside the rule that fixes the ruling comment's first line — body-first-line and comment-first-line are siblings. It also reaches every path that records a ruling: the 一类自裁 self-ruling that 录裁转工作态 without going to a batch, the 代裁 channel, and the maintainer's 一行回批 alike. Under 职责二 決裁勤务 the same text would read as scoped to the batch-reply path, which is the one path the two measured instances did **not** take alone.

## Measurements taken on this branch

- **PM assumption 1 — confirmed.** On the branch base, `grep -nE 'banner|正文|body'` over the charter returns **0 hits**, exit 1; the positive control `grep -n 'Ruling:'` hits line 11, exit 0. The ruling procedure had no body-side act.
- **PM assumption 2 — refuted in its present tense, and the refutation is useful.** objectui#7508 and objectui#7750 no longer read as the card describes: both bodies now open with a hand-written multi-line blockquote banner (「⛔⛔ THIS CARD IS RULED…」) naming the ruling date, the letter, the ruling comment id and the recorded `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` transition, with the stale paragraph left in place below it and explicitly marked stale. objectui#7750's `updated_at` reads 2026-09-20T05:58Z — the filing round's own remediation of the two instances, not a mechanism. Nothing in `.claude/skills/**` spells that shape (`grep -rn 'CARD IS RULED'` over `.claude/` and `scripts/pm/`: 0 hits), so the gap the card names is live and this PR is what makes the remediation a rule. The landed clause is a floor: a one-line banner, which the two measured bodies exceed.
- **PM assumption 3 — confirmed.** `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs` spells the flag as an `ack-through` option belonging to a `--body` refresh, refusing a body write while unacknowledged newer comments exist and refusing an id that is not the newest. Re-verified against current `origin/main` after the merge below (17 occurrences), since that file moved on main while this branch was open.
- **PM assumption 4 — confirmed.** `check:pm-skill-id-lint` exits 0: the landed lines cite no card, and the two objectui instances appear only in this PR body.
- **Governed tier.** `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --test .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/director.md` → GOVERNED, **Tier S** (`.claude/**`), 1 of 1 path hitting the register. This PR stays DRAFT; the owning seat lands it on a `## Contract review` record for the current head.

## ⛔ One gate is RED, and it cannot be greened from this PR's declared file surface

`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` → **exit 1**, its own verdict line:

> ✗ check-skill-line-ratchet: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/director.md is 75 lines; the ratchet ceiling is 72. … Raising a ceiling requires a maintainer ruling quoted in the PR.

The arithmetic, in full:

| reading | value |
|---|---|
| file before / after | 72 → 75 lines (+3 added, 0 deleted, 0 re-wrapped) |
| dispatch net-line budget | net ≤ +4 — **satisfied** |
| ratchet ceiling | 72, **headroom 0** |
| new lines, widest to narrowest | 117 B · 105 B · 96 B, all under the 120-byte per-line cap |
| file's widest line | 118 B before and after — unchanged |
| losslessly compressible slack | **none**: of the file's adjacent bullet pairs the smallest merges to 129 B against the 120-byte cap, so zero pairs merge |

So the two currencies the ratchet accepts are both unavailable here. Deleting content is not one: every line in this charter is a live rule with a reader, and cutting one would be a scope expansion this card does not authorize. Re-wrap is not one either — there is no soft-break slack to reclaim, and buying lines for new content with a re-wrap is forbidden to a dev seat regardless.

That leaves the route the ratchet itself names and the ceiling row's own history records — the row was raised 75 → 77 once before on exactly this file at headroom 0, paid for by a maintainer directive that dictated the lines. **That raise is not in this PR's file surface** (`scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` is not `director.md`), and a dev seat does not set it. The lines are landed, the ceiling row is untouched, and the measured count is reported red rather than hidden. To green this PR the ceiling row needs 72 → 75 with the authorizing ruling quoted in the raising PR.

## Verification

Gate union derived and run on the final head `af00eb6`, with each exit code captured before any pipe:

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths) → 16 commands, byte-identical to the derivation the dispatch carried.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran …` → ✓ 16 derived families accounted for — 16 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero: all 16 recorded an exit code and none is 3).
- **15 green, 1 red**: `check:pm-skill-ratchet` exit 1, above. Green: `check-closing-keyword-parity` (and its self-test), `check-comment-mask-corpus`, `check-harness-current --self-test`, `check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:agent-test-spelling`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:driver-memory-census`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:pm-governed-merges`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:refd-timer-probe`, `check:skill-frame-sync`, `check:watch-hint-literal`.
- `check:pm-settings-deny-roster` → exit 0, run on purpose: the derivation marks it as keeping its roster under `.claude/`, where silence is evidence in neither direction.
- Control-character self-scan over the changed file beyond `check:nul-bytes`: `grep -naP` for the C0 set and DEL returns no match.
- `origin/main` was merged into the branch (it had moved 3 commits, one of them `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs`, which the new clause names); `director.md` was untouched on main and the branch diff is still exactly +3 lines in that one file. Build state was refreshed for the one package the union needs compiled (`@objectstack/lint` and its closure) rather than the whole tree — a declared narrowing, since the diff is three markdown lines.

No changeset: `.claude/**` publishes nothing from any released package. Label `skip-changeset` applied.

## Acceptance notes

Noted, not filed — neither is a reproducible defect, a declared-contract violation, or a metadata-authoring trap:

- The banner actually written onto the two objectui bodies is a multi-line blockquote carrying the ruling's substance, not the single line this clause requires. The clause is deliberately a floor and the richer form satisfies it; whether the charter should fix the richer shape is a question for whoever next edits this file. 承接者:无 — no queued PR or card touches this charter.
- The ruling-comment first line spells `Ruling:` with a batch and item number; the body banner spells `Ruled:` with the comment id. The asymmetry is intentional — the body must point at a retrievable id, which the charter's 出决策箱须引可取回的裁决 id rule already requires — but the two spellings sitting one line apart will invite a future author to unify them. 承接者:无.
